summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new SEO/GEO/AEO public discovery layer. Verified 20 public routes render (H1 + content, zero JS page errors), per-page metadata via react-helmet-async, JSON-LD blocks (BreadcrumbList/FAQPage/Article/JobPosting/Organization/WebSite - all valid JSON), AEO answer blocks, FAQ expand, breadcrumbs, internal linking (skill chips, related careers, job cards, footer 26 links on every public page), jobs hub search filter, CTA -> /register, sitemap.xml + sitemap-pages.xml (31 <loc>), mobile 390x844 (no horizontal overflow), and auth regression (employer login -> /employer). Two real SEO defects found: duplicate canonical/description tags (static index.html not overridden by Helmet) and hub pages missing product-cta; plus homepage has zero internal links into the discovery layer.

ui_bugs.issue: index.html contains static <meta name="description"> and <link rel="canonical" href=".../"> without data-rh="true", so react-helmet-async APPENDS its tags instead of replacing them. Every public page therefore ships TWO canonical tags (first/static one points to homepage '/') and TWO meta descriptions (first is the generic site one). Same for og:description and twitter:description. Crawlers reading the first match get the wrong canonical -> all discovery pages canonicalize to the homepage. Fix: remove those tags from index.html (or add data-rh="true").

Requirement 'Every public page has a data-testid=product-cta' fails on the 4 hub pages: /careers, /skills, /jobs, /market-insights have no product-cta (detail pages all have it). These hubs also have no answer-block.

Homepage has ZERO links into the crawlable discovery layer (all anchors are #hash, /login, /register). Landing uses its own header/footer, not PublicLayout, so /careers, /skills, /jobs, /locations, /about... are orphan pages from the site root - weakens internal-link discovery even though they are in sitemap-pages.xml.
Submit button has no type="submit" and no data-testid (only accessible name 'Sign in'), making automated auth flows brittle.
/jobs/{id} and /companies/{id} have no data-testid=answer-block (AEO direct answer) unlike career/skill/location/static pages. Not explicitly required but inconsistent for AEO coverage.

issues: Landing nav (Talent/Employers/How It Works/Match Intelligence/Outcomes) differs from public nav (Careers/Jobs/Skills/Insights/How It Works); 'How It Works' on landing goes to /#how while the public page /how-it-works exists - inconsistent destinations for the same label.

action_items: Remove (or mark data-rh="true") the static meta description + canonical + og/twitter description in /app/frontend/public/index.html so Helmet's per-page tags are not duplicated; re-verify only ONE canonical per page matching the path.
Add ProductCta (and ideally an AnswerBlock) to the /careers, /skills, /jobs and /market-insights hub pages.
Add discovery-layer internal links (careers/skills/locations/company pages) to the landing page footer so hubs are reachable from '/'.
Add type="submit" and data-testid to the login submit button.
critical_code_review_comments: Seo.jsx cannot dedupe tags that pre-exist in index.html without data-rh markers - single source of truth for head tags should be the Seo component only.
Titles are unique across all 20 pages and JSON-LD is valid on every page tested; robots meta is correct ('index,follow,max-image-preview:large').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS: all 20 public routes render with unique titles + valid JSON-LD (careers detail = BreadcrumbList+FAQPage+Article, /jobs/role-acme-da = BreadcrumbList+JobPosting+FAQPage with title/hiringOrganization/datePosted/baseSalary, home = Organization+WebSite+FAQPage); answer-block present on career/skill/location/about/how-it-works/trust/methodology/ai/for-* pages; faq-0 expands on click; breadcrumbs link back to hub; skill chips -> /skills/*, related-* -> /careers/*, /skills/sql -> /jobs/role-acme-da & /jobs/role-helios-ds; jobs-search filters 3->1 for 'backend'; product-cta on /careers/data-analyst navigates to /register; sitemap.xml sitemapindex OK, sitemap-pages.xml urlset with exactly 31 <loc>; mobile 390x844 no overflow, Get Started visible; public nav links all resolve correctly (test from a public page, NOT from '/', since landing has a different nav). First job id: role-acme-da. After fixes, re-check canonical/description tag COUNT (must be 1 each) and hub product-cta.
rca_of_the_issue: react-helmet-async only replaces head tags it manages (identified by data-rh); tags hard-coded in public/index.html lack that attribute, so both the static and the dynamic canonical/description coexist. The static canonical hard-codes the site root, so every discovery page presents a homepage canonical to the first-match parser.
